_doc: Hand-verified ILS facts merged by tools/14_ils.py over the AIP India records of tools/29_ils_aip.py (same key: airport + runway end). Entry: {airport, runway, ident, freq_mhz, category (1-3, optional), gs_deg (optional), source (where it was verified)}; {airport, runway, remove: true} drops an AIP record. Only add facts you checked in an official source or that the project owner confirmed (say which in `source`).

entries.source: ident and frequency from AIP India AD 2.19 (tools/29_ils_aip.py); CAT I confirmed by the project owner 2026-11-26 (the AIP page gives no category)
